bio.text: Jason T. Dickerson, a Republican, has served in the Georgia State Senate since 2025 and represents District 21, which includes portions of Cherokee and Fulton counties.

The legislature biography says Dickerson is a lifelong Cherokee County resident who grew up on a farm in Union Hill, co-founded the long-haul trucking company Quest Trucking, and is founder and president of the investment firm Purple Chip Capital Management.
